newsitem.title: CHINA: China rescues 51 kidnapped children, nabs gang.
newsitem.headline: China rescues 51 kidnapped children, nabs gang.

text.p: Police in northern China have arrested 61 members of a gang that kidnapped children and sold them, the People's Daily said on Tuesday.
Police in Handan city in northern Hebei province recently rescued 51 kidnapped children in Hebei and the southwestern provinces of Sichuan and Yunnan, the newspaper said.
It did not say when the rescue took place but said the investigation took two years and covered thousands of miles (km).

Authorities began investigations after receiving a tip-off that Gao Guozhou, a farmer, and his wife, Wu Xiujun, pocketed 100,000 yuan ($12,000) from the sale of kidnapped children, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
Kidnapping children and women, an ancient scourge, has staged a comeback in the past two decades as economic reforms have loosened social controls.
Many women victims are raped and then sold as brides to farmers or into prostitution.
The abduction of children has become common again because of strict population controls -- one child per family -- and the traditional Chinese preference for male children.
